revisions.goal: Eliminate EVE CPU spikes across the daemon, dashboard, repository watcher, and agent-presence stack under many simultaneous clients while preserving prompt event-driven updates.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria: No timer-based dashboard polling; hidden tabs do not maintain live event activity; bursty filesystem changes produce bounded/coalesced refreshes; concurrent identical API requests share expensive derivation work; agent running/waiting/offline state remains correct; multi-client idle CPU is at measurement floor and event-driven updates still arrive promptly; all Go/UI/race tests pass.

milestones.title: Reproduce and measure fan-out
milestones.goal: Add a deterministic multi-client benchmark/regression seam that exposes repeated repository derivation and event bursts.

milestones.title: Coalesce runtime work
milestones.goal: Deduplicate bursty filesystem notifications and share expensive repository/Git derivations across concurrent API clients.

milestones.title: Suspend hidden dashboard activity
milestones.goal: Keep hidden tabs disconnected from live events and recover state when visible, preventing background-tab fan-out.

milestones.title: Verify whole-stack behavior
milestones.goal: Run Go, race, UI, browser, and multi-client CPU/request benchmarks against the optimized runtime.
